scope: DataTable logic, compact neon styling, container responsiveness and final rendered documentation

baseline.primaryDefect: Pinned table forced1016px within1468px available content area; row action visible label37px clipped to27px; header controls overflowed; container-specific responsiveness absent

changes: Distribute unused container width among flexible data columns; recompute actual pinned offsets from those same widths. Observe only pinned container width, disconnect on unmount.
Use colgroup as the single column-width owner. Do not copy fixed table widths onto card cells, where40px/120px widths clipped utility labels and actions.
Default row action slot120px, explicit overrides retained. Visible action header and mobile detail/action captions.
Header controls stay within each column. Numeric header text aligns with right-aligned values; filter and sorting controls retain access. Subtle pinned dividers retain the neon theme.
Compact standard rows and group bands without shrinking text or action control hit area.
Header section forms a stacking context, preventing sticky body utility cells from painting over selection/row-number headings.
Container queries replace viewport-only cards. Narrow pinned tables use local horizontal scroll and suspend sticky horizontal offsets so left/right cells cannot overlap.
Mobile cards retain a visible compact header control grid with sort/filter/select-all. Header controls remain keyboard/mouse accessible rather than living inside a1px clipped region.
Reset view is offered when only density or expanded details changed and restores both.
Own-key lookups keep constructor/toString/__proto__ column widths finite and missing row data empty. Computed-property filter updates store __proto__ safely as an own field.

measurements.interpretation: Geometry and bounded DOM counts, not a physical low-end device speed claim.

contractNotes: rowActionsWidth default increases96→120px to fit standard small icon+label Button; provided overrides still determine the slot.
Pinned tables fill free container width. Auto columns absorb extra space; when every column has an explicit width, free space is shared to avoid an empty table region.
Card layout threshold is48rem of component container, not viewport. Pinned/virtual tables retain local horizontal scrolling.
Styling tests updated only where old internals changed: container query, CSS-variable pin offset fallback and colgroup width ownership. No disabled checks or unconditional success paths.

Initial light-preset screenshots before cards-red used the dark scheme; final screenshots explicitly set light colorScheme. Root corrected shared Badge contrast independently, final images include that correction.
limitations: Headless installed Chrome only in this agent pass; parent owns packed Chrome/Edge verification.
No physical touchscreen, low-end hardware, screen reader speech or Safari/Firefox run.
Pinned tables may require local horizontal scroll below their minimum useful column width; no page overflow detected.
Group collapse intentionally follows existing pagination behavior (collapsed rows excluded from current visible pages); no new contract introduced.
